reason: My son or a neighbour already brings my shopping, so I don't need another way. I'm not going to pay a stranger to shop for me, and I'm not good with WhatsApp voice notes.
objection: Why pay anyone when family brings it for free? And I'd have to walk to a pickup point in the evening and carry the bag myself, with cash I don't have much of.
would_change_my_mind: Delivery to my door, free, and someone I know in the village taking my order by phone or in person.
